subtitle: Basic se Advance: Theory, Short Tricks aur 1139 Practice Questions

chapters.title: Number System
theory: Natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational numbers. Prime = exactly 2 factors; 1 prime nahi hai.
Divisibility: 3/9 = digit sum; 4 = last 2 digits; 8 = last 3; 11 = alternate digit sum ka difference 0 ya 11 ka multiple.
N = a^p x b^q ho to factors = (p+1)(q+1).
short_tricks: Unit digit: power ko 4 se divide karo; remainder 0 ho to power 4 lo.
1 se n tak sum = n(n+1)/2.

chapters.title: HCF and LCM
theory: HCF = sabse bada common divisor. LCM = sabse chhota common multiple.
Do numbers ke liye: HCF x LCM = product.
Fractions: HCF = HCF(num)/LCM(den); LCM = LCM(num)/HCF(den).
short_tricks: HCF ke liye numbers ka difference check karo.
'Same remainder k' wale sawal: LCM + k.

chapters.title: Simplification and Algebra Basics
theory: BODMAS: Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.
short_tricks: Bade squares ko identity se solve karo.
Options ka last digit check karke eliminate karo.

chapters.title: Percentage
theory: a% increase ke baad b% change: net = a + b + ab/100 (decrease negative).
short_tricks: x% of y = y% of x.

chapters.title: Profit, Loss and Discount
theory: Profit = SP - CP. Profit% CP par nikalta hai.
Discount Marked Price (MP) par hota hai. SP = MP(100-d)/100.
short_tricks: Successive discount a, b: a + b - ab/100.

chapters.title: Simple Interest
theory: SI = P x R x T / 100. Amount = P + SI.
short_tricks: SI har saal same rehta hai.

chapters.title: Compound Interest
theory: Amount = P(1 + R/100)^T. CI = Amount - P.
Half-yearly: rate aadha, periods double.
short_tricks: 2 saal ka CI - SI = P(R/100)^2.
3 saal: P x r^2 x (3+r), r = R/100.

chapters.title: Ratio, Proportion and Partnership
theory: a:b = c:d ho to ad = bc.
Partnership: profit ratio = investment x time.
short_tricks: Ratio parts ka sum nikalo, phir 1 part ki value.

chapters.title: Averages
theory: Average = Sum / Count. Sum = Average x Count.
short_tricks: Naya member aaye: new value = new avg + purane count x avg change.

chapters.title: Problems on Ages
theory: Present age x maano. n saal baad x+n, pehle x-n.
Do logon ka age difference hamesha constant rehta hai.
short_tricks: Options ko seedha equation me daal ke check karo.

chapters.title: Time and Work
theory: A kaam d din me kare to 1 din ka kaam 1/d.
M1 D1 H1 / W1 = M2 D2 H2 / W2.
short_tricks: LCM method: total work = LCM of days, phir efficiency nikalo.
chapters.solved_example: A=10, B=15 din: LCM 30, eff 3+2=5, together 6 din.

chapters.title: Pipes and Cisterns
theory: Inlet ka kaam positive, outlet/leak ka negative.
short_tricks: Time and Work jaisa hi LCM method lagao.
chapters.solved_example: Fill 10 h, empty 15 h: net 1/30, 30 h.

chapters.title: Time, Speed and Distance
theory: Distance = Speed x Time.
km/h se m/s: x 5/18.
short_tricks: Equal distance par speed a, b: average = 2ab/(a+b).

chapters.title: Problems on Trains
theory: Pole cross karne me distance = train length; platform me = train + platform.
Opposite direction: speeds add. Same direction: subtract.
short_tricks: Pehle unit match karo.
chapters.solved_example: 150 m train 54 km/h (15 m/s): pole 10 s.

chapters.title: Boats and Streams
theory: Downstream = b + s; Upstream = b - s.

chapters.title: Mixtures and Alligation
theory: Alligation: cheaper qty : dearer qty = (D - M) : (M - C).
short_tricks: Replacement: bacha pure = V(1 - x/V)^n.

chapters.title: Permutation and Combination
theory: nPr = n!/(n-r)!; nCr = n!/(r!(n-r)!).
Order matter kare to P, warna C.
short_tricks: Repeated letters: n!/(p! q!). 'Together' wale ko ek block maano.

chapters.title: Probability
theory: P(E) = favourable / total. 0 se 1 ke beech.
P(not E) = 1 - P(E).
short_tricks: 'At least one' = 1 - P(none).
Do dice: 36 outcomes. Cards: 52, 4 suits, 12 face cards.
chapters.solved_example: Do coins me at least ek head: 3/4.

chapters.title: Mensuration
theory: Rectangle: A=lb, P=2(l+b). Triangle: A=bh/2. Circle: A=pi r^2, C=2 pi r.
Cuboid V=lbh; Cylinder V=pi r^2 h.
short_tricks: Side x% badhe to area change = 2x + x^2/100 %.

chapters.title: Number Series
theory: Differences, second differences, ratio, squares/cubes aur alternate series check karo.
short_tricks: Pehle difference, phir ratio, phir alternate terms dekho.

chapters.title: Coding-Decoding
theory: Letter positions: A=1 ... Z=26. Shift, reverse ya opposite letter pattern check karo.
short_tricks: EJOTY = 5,10,15,20,25. Opposite pair ka position sum 27.

chapters.title: Direction Sense
theory: North upar, East right. Right turn = clockwise.
Shortest distance = root(x^2 + y^2).
chapters.solved_example: 3 km N, 4 km E: distance 5 km.

chapters.title: Ranking and Order
theory: Total = rank from left + rank from right - 1.
short_tricks: Interchange wale sawal me naya position seedha formula me daalo.

chapters.title: Clocks
theory: Hour hand 0.5 deg/min, minute hand 6 deg/min.
short_tricks: Angle = |30H - 5.5M|; 180 se zyada ho to 360 - angle.

chapters.title: Calendar
theory: Ordinary year = 1 odd day, leap year = 2.
Century year leap tab jab 400 se divisible ho.
short_tricks: Din nikalne ke liye total days mod 7.
chapters.solved_example: Aaj Monday ho to 10 din baad Thursday.

chapters.title: Syllogism
theory: Conclusion tabhi follow karega jab har possible Venn diagram me true ho.
Is chapter me maana gaya hai ki har group me kam se kam ek member hai.
short_tricks: All A-B + All B-C = All A-C.
Some + Some se koi definite conclusion nahi.
chapters.solved_example: All cats are pets, all pets are animals: all cats are animals.

chapters.title: Grammar: Error and Fill in the Blanks
theory: Subject-verb agreement: singular subject ke saath singular verb.
since = starting point, for = duration. Each/every ke saath singular verb.
short_tricks: Beech ke phrase (along with, of the) ko hata ke subject pehchano.
chapters.solved_example: The list of items IS on the desk.

chapters.title: Vocabulary: Synonyms and Antonyms
theory: Synonym = same meaning, antonym = opposite meaning.
short_tricks: Prefix se guess karo: bene = good, mal = bad.

chapters.title: Idioms and One-word Substitution
theory: Idiom ka matlab uske words se alag hota hai.
short_tricks: Sentence context se meaning guess karo.
